## Status

Status is a declared field. verified means the gates passed. broken means a gate failed.

<div class="entity-table">
<table>
<thead>

<tr><td data-label="Value"><code>broken</code></td><td data-label="Kind">live</td><td data-label="Meaning">A required gate failed</td></tr>

## Constraints

- A capability is not a path into implementation
- Implementation still requires an approved plan
- verified requires every must-pass gate to exit 0

## Validate

<pre><code>backstop artifact validate --all</code></pre>

## Reviewer

Capabilities do not have a dedicated reviewer agent.

- The validator checks identity, scenarios, and traceability to specs

## Notes

Specs prove units. A capability proves the user journey those units enable.

Product code is not written from the capability file.
